description: Declares layout slots for an app and which widget phases are allowed or denied per slot. GEMMA app generator respects this when ranking registry candidates.
note: Phase names the user journey stage; slot names the physical layout position. They are independent axes. Same phase can appear in multiple slots (Pop nav appears in header AND footer) but under slot-specific names.

header.description: Top of page — logo, primary nav, hero, session status
header.note: Hero and slideshow ONLY in header. footer-menu is a DIFFERENT component from header-nav.

footer.description: Bottom of page — secondary links, legal, final CTA, newsletter
footer.note: Menus are allowed but must be named footer-menu, not header-nav. No full-bleed heroes.

sidebar-left.description: Left panel — section navigation, categories, filters, tree

sidebar-right.description: Right panel — contextual info, TOC, related links, quick widgets

content.description: Main content area — feeds, grids, forms, chat, maps
content.note: Most permissive slot. Hero only in header.

admin-panel.description: Admin area — user management, settings, audit log

modal.description: Overlay — forms, confirmations, auth, media preview

core.description: Background services — plugins and micronauts that have no UI

naming_convention.rule: Slot-specific widgets carry the slot name as a prefix or qualifier.

examples.hero: widget:hero-slideshow — header slot only, never footer

app_spec_usage.description: An app's slot_contract overrides this default. GEMMA filters registry candidates by slot.allowed_phases before cosine-ranking.
